name: Donner-Houghton House (156 E St. John St)
shape_note: Two-storey Victorian (Tasha Donner / Sherman O. Houghton), NRHP 2002; vacant, destroyed by a four-alarm fire 19 Jul 2007 and demolished for safety (removed from the NRHP 2013). start_year = HRI ESTIMATEDYR c1881 (ESTIMATE); end_year 2007 from the fire report (demolition late 2007, month not verified). HRI IDNUMBER 904 (its TRUEYR field says 2017: the HRI year field of demolished resources is NOT the demolition year). Position = HRI point. 1915: outside traced coverage; 1950: outside traced coverage.

name: San Jose City Hall in the plaza (Market Plaza / City Park)
shape_note: City hall in the middle of the plaza (now Plaza de Cesar Chavez), 1887-1958 per Metro Silicon Valley 1997 ('Old City Hall'), demolished 1958 after the city moved to the new civic centre on N. First St. Footprint traced from the 1915 Sanborn sheet 90 (id 004_0090_b16, brick, 972 m2; 1950 sheet: 008_0090_b50) - prefer the traced geometry; height not found. start_year: construction 1887-1889 (ESTIMATE 1887 as given by the source).

name: Hotel Montgomery at its original site (S. First St at San Antonio St)
shape_note: William Binder's 1911 hotel was moved 57 m (187 ft) south on 29 Jan 2000 to 211 S. First St, where it stands (reopened 2004): this row is the building at its first site only (1911-2000). Footprint traced from the 1915 Sanborn sheet 90 (004_0090_f56, 2,198 m2 incl. the wing; 1950: 008_0090_x84). Storeys 4 = ESTIMATE from photos (not read off the sheet).
